rows.name: Nico's Pier 38 Fish Market
rows.notes: Fish market is attached to Nico's Pier 38 restaurant, 1129 N Nimitz Hwy, Honolulu 96817 (town). Fish Market phone 808-983-1263, per Nico's own lunch menu PDF. The market shares the restaurant's Instagram, Facebook and Threads (@nicospier38), and its homepage has a 'Fish Market Specials' section. Facebook shows a post from 2 days before the search. The site mentions 'Order Online' but I did not confirm an exact order URL, so order_url is null. Fixed location, so there are no market stops. Nico's Kailua (nicoskailua.com) is a separate location.

rows.name: Pier 38 Fish Market
rows.notes: This is a different business from Nico's Pier 38. It is the retail arm of Fresh Island Fish at 1135 N Nimitz Hwy, Honolulu (town). The Instagram handle and the shop.pier38fishmarket.com address come from an Aloha State Daily article (Dec 2025). Slow Food Oahu gives the pier38fishmarket.com website, phone (808) 784-4988, and Tue-Sat opening. I did not open the site or Instagram directly. No Facebook page found. Hours are not independently confirmed, so schedule_source_url is null.

rows.name: Alicia's Market
rows.notes: 267 Mokauea St, Kalihi (town), phone (808) 841-1921. A Hawaii News Now story (Oct 2025) and a Sept 2026 guide, nateeatshawaii.com, both describe it as operating; the guide gives Mon-Sat 10 AM-2 PM and lists aliciasmarket.com. I did not open the website directly. I found no Instagram or Facebook account I could tie to this business. Fixed location.

rows.name: Honolulu Fish Company
rows.notes: Seafood distributor (wholesale and consumer delivery) at 824 Gulick Ave, Honolulu 96819 (Kalihi; town), phone (808) 833-1123. Its LinkedIn lists honolulufishmarket.com as the website; honolulufish.com is also listed in directories and as its X profile website. It also sells through O'ahu Fresh (shop.oahufresh.com). No dated recent source found, so still_active is null. Instagram and Facebook not verified (X account @HonoluluFishCo exists but looks old). This is a distributor, not a market vendor with stops. I could not confirm an order URL.

rows.name: Maguro Brothers Hawaii
rows.notes: Assumed to be the original Chinatown stall at Maunakea Marketplace, 1120 Maunakea St Ste 111-112 (town), phone (808) 259-7100; the address and phone come from Yelp and Goop, so treat them as unconfirmed. The official site homepage I could see lists only the Waikiki shop (5-8pm, closed Sundays). I could not confirm the Chinatown stall is currently open, so still_active is null. The site mentions online preorder of sashimi platters but I found no exact URL. No Instagram or Facebook account found.

rows.name: Maguro Brothers Hawaii Waikīkī
rows.notes: 2250 Kalākaua Ave (Waikiki Shopping Plaza, Royal Hawaiian Ave side), phone (808) 230-3470 (town). The official site lists Waikiki 5pm-8pm, closed Sundays. That page snapshot is roughly a year old; a booking site (joinpearl.co) marks its details as current to Oct 2026. The site offers sashimi platter preorders but I found no exact URL. No Instagram or Facebook account verified.

rows.name: Morning Catch
rows.notes: Poke stall at O'ahu Market, 145 N King St #12, Chinatown (town), phone (808) 840-7155. Honolulu Magazine gives the handle @morningcatchoahu, and TikTok visitors tag the same handle. The Canva website comes from the Apple Maps listing. Honolulu Magazine says there is also a second stall at Kekaulike Market (opened 2023), which I did not verify is still open. Recent public posts from about a month ago show visitors, which suggests it is operating. Hours are stated as about 9-9:30 AM to 2 PM daily on those sources, but I did not confirm them on an official page.

rows.name: 88 Fresh Fish
rows.notes: Listed as '88 Fresh Fish Market' at O'ahu Market, 145 N King St #23, Chinatown (town), phone (808) 524-6988. Its Facebook page says to call or walk in to order. The Chinatown community site hiChinatown gave daily hours of 8am-2pm in a listing about 4 months old. No website or Instagram account found.

rows.name: Blue Seafood Company
rows.notes: Seafood market and food-court stall at Maunakea Marketplace, 1120 Maunakea St Ste 168, Chinatown (town), phone 808-888-0078. It opened in Feb 2025. Aloha State Daily gives the Instagram handle @blueseafoodcompany, and Great Eats Hawaii links the same account. Hawaii News Now covered it in June 2025, and I found no later non-review source, so still_active is null. No website or Facebook found. Hours differ across sources, so I left them out.

rows.name: Yama's Fish Market
rows.notes: 2332 Young St, Honolulu 96826 (McCully-Mōʻiliʻili; town), phone (808) 941-9994. The Instagram and Facebook URLs come from the site's own structured data. The site says to order online for pickup or catering and shows a 2026 copyright. The contact page gives Tue-Thu and Sun 9am-5pm, Fri-Sat 9am-7pm, closed Monday. Fixed location with takeout and catering.

rows.name: Ono Seafood
rows.notes: Assumed to be the original Kapahulu shop, 747 Kapahulu Ave, phone 808-732-4806 (town). Onolicious Hawaiʻi lists instagram.com/ono.seafood. A HI Now story (May 2026) says the business is operating, with a Hawaii Kai location and a Poke Bowl Patrol truck at the Kakaʻako Farmers Market on Saturdays. I left the website null: onoseafood.org, referenced for the Hawaii Kai location on Yelp, could not be confirmed as official. Several other onoseafood sites look like unofficial SEO pages and I did not use them. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Fresh Catch
rows.notes: Interpreted as the Kapahulu shop at 1113 Kapahulu Ave, Honolulu 96816 (town), phone (808) 735-7653. The official site's locations section lists this address and links to Facebook, Instagram, Yelp and Tripadvisor; I could not retrieve the Facebook URL. The Instagram bio says 'Order Online : freshcatch808'. A Sept 2026 guide, nateeatshawaii.com, lists it as open Tue-Sun. I did not confirm an exact order URL. The seed name is ambiguous because there is also a Kāneʻohe location.

rows.name: Fresh Catch Kāneʻohe
rows.notes: Kāneʻohe (windward) location at 45-1002 Kamehameha Hwy, phone (808) 235-7653. Wanderlog and Yelp list freshcatch808.com, and Wanderlog links a Kāneʻohe page on that site. The homepage text I retrieved lists only Kapahulu under Locations, so I could not confirm the Kāneʻohe shop is still open. The brand's Instagram (@freshcatch808) is tied to the Kapahulu shop and may be shared, so I left it null here. Older sources show an earlier address, 45-1118 Kamehameha Hwy.

rows.name: Off the Hook Poke Market
rows.notes: 2908 E Manoa Rd, Honolulu 96822 (Mānoa; town), phone (808) 800-6865. The Facebook page says open 10am-6pm Mon-Sat, closed Sunday. The website domain comes from a Waze listing, and I did not open it. I found no dated recent source other than third-party pages, so still_active is null. I found no Instagram account I could tie to this business; a handle in a Yelp caption belongs to a customer.

rows.name: Tamura's Fine Wine & Liquors Waiʻalae
rows.notes: The Waialae Ave store is at 3496 Waialae Ave, Honolulu 96816 (Kaimuki), phone (808) 735-7100. Tamura's is a multi-location chain; its site mentions a poke bar and has a poke menu page. Sources, including Tamura's own site, spell it 'Waialae', without the ʻokina. Hours from a third-party listing are 9:30am-8pm. I found no Instagram or Facebook account I could verify, and the site is chain-wide rather than store-specific.
